text:
Aleksander Barkov is back. The Panthers captain missed all of last season after knee surgery, played twice at the start of this one, then went out again until Wednesday, when he scored against Ottawa in 18.3 minutes. The team's own video caught the moment in his words: "You made it special for me." Florida waived Cole Reinhardt to make room for him and Brad Marchand.

Three games tell us almost nothing, and our numbers know it: his season projection runs all the way from 19 to 47 points, with 31 in the middle. What we do know is the player. He has three Selke Trophies, and Evolving-Hockey's last full look at him, 2024-25, had most of his 2.2 wins above replacement coming from defense, with opponents getting 0.21 fewer expected goals per 60 against him (96th percentile) while he faced the other team's best. NHL EDGE puts his top speed so far in the bottom 3% of forwards, a number to revisit once he has a few weeks of games behind him.
headline: Barkov's emotional return, and what to expect
